primary.usage: Logo only. Bold, wide display style.

secondary.usage: All UI, HUD text, manifesto, labels, overlays, and captions.

rules: All HUD text should use tight tracking or standard monospace layout.
UI text is dark slate (#1B2330) on light world backgrounds.
Overlays and labels must have bracketed corners e.g., [ CLOSE ].
NO DARK MODE. NO BLACK BACKGROUNDS.
Shadows are soft cool grey, never black.
Accent color per flavor appears ONLY in the liquid, the drops, and small UI details. The rest of the world stays pale grey-white.

visual enhancers.glass_shader: Use @react-three/drei <MeshTransmissionMaterial> for the 3D bottle and ingredient drops. High transmission, low roughness, subtle chromatic aberration.
visual enhancers.post_processing: Use @react-three/postprocessing. Add Bloom (soft, on bright areas), Noise (subtle film grain, opacity 0.05), Vignette (gentle, white/light-grey instead of black), and DepthOfField (blur on far mountains).
visual enhancers.hud_styling: Technical minimalist HUD. 1px solid lines (#1B2330 with 20% opacity), thin leader lines for 3D annotations, bracketed corners for buttons. Mix-blend-mode: multiply for dark text to sit perfectly on light backgrounds.
visual enhancers.loader: Pixel-style loader on a flat pale-grey (#E9EDF2) screen.

grids.hud_grid: Absolute positioning over the fullscreen canvas. Split into 4 corners: Top-Left (Logo), Top-Right (Manifesto), Bottom-Left (Scroll + Sound), Bottom-Right (Counter/Controls).
grids.overlay_layout: Centered or off-centered modal with 1px border, backdrop blur, padding p-8 or p-12, left-aligned monospace text.

layouts.general: Zero template conventions: no navbar, no hero button, no feature cards, no testimonials, no pricing, no footer sections. The canvas is the whole page.
layouts.dom_overlay: Fixed 100vh 100vw container, pointer-events-none, z-50. Interactive DOM elements get pointer-events-auto.
scene_flow: 1. Hero: 3D beverage bottle on a plateau.
2. Drag: Bottle breaks into spilling liquid particles.
4. Drops: 7 floating glass 'ingredient drops' with molecule line art.
5. Tunnel: Bright circular white-light tunnel zoom.
6. Platform: Final circular platform, glowing rings, particle figure (bottle morphing into a drop), social links.

motion.scroll: Scroll-driven WebGL using @react-three/drei <ScrollControls> and useScroll hook. Map scroll offset to camera position and scene transitions.
motion.drag: Keyboard-accessible spill control + mouse drag mapping using useDrag from @use-gesture/react.
motion.text: Text scramble/glitch effects on HUD updates and overlay opens. Use Framer Motion or a custom scramble text hook.
motion.transitions: Smooth interpolation (THREE.MathUtils.damp) for camera movement and material property changes.
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: Provide a static no-WebGL fallback or skip complex camera animations if true.

accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Spill control must be keyboard accessible (e.g., Arrow keys).
accessibility.screen_reader: Include visually hidden descriptive text for the 3D canvas and scenes.
accessibility.motion: Static fallback or reduced motion for WebGL animations.

media.audio: Synthesized Web Audio sound. Managed by a global sound toggle (Sound: On/Off).
media.textures: Minimal use. Procedural noise for terrain, pure procedural materials. No heavy stock images.

3d libraries.animation: framer-motion, gsap (optional, for timeline control if needed)

terrain_texture.description: Use procedural Three.js noise/displacement for the rocky/snowy terrain. No image URLs needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add three @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei @react-three/postprocessing framer-motion @use-gesture/react lucide-react
Set up the main App.js as a fullscreen fixed wrapper containing the <Canvas> and the HTML <HUD> overlay.
Use <ScrollControls> from @react-three/drei to drive the entire experience. Map the scroll offset (0 to 1) to the camera's Z/Y position and rotation to fly through the scenes.

TERRAIN: Create a wide 3D mountain landscape. Layered snowy and rocky mountains. Use THREE.PlaneGeometry with displacement or basic sculpted meshes. Lighting: soft diffused sunlight from a low angle, bright overcast sky, subtle volumetric light. Add `<fog attach="fog" args={['#DFE4EA', 10, 50]} />`.
BOTTLE & DROPS: Use `<MeshTransmissionMaterial>` from drei for the glass. The liquid inside is the ONLY place where accent colors (#2E8BFF or #E91E5A) are used.
PARTICLES: Use `<Sparkles>` or a custom `<points>` system for the dragging/spilling liquid effect, and the final particle figure.

OVERLAYS & ROUTING: When an ingredient drop is clicked, show an HTML overlay over the canvas (bg-[#E9EDF2]/90 backdrop-blur), update the URL to `/ingredient/[name]` using window.history.pushState without unmounting the canvas.

HUD: Pure React DOM overlay. Use Space Mono. Elements: Logo top-left, `//// Copyright 2026...` top-right, `Scroll down` bottom-left, etc. Apply text scramble effects using Framer Motion when labels change.
Ensure the post-processing pipeline uses Bloom, Noise (film grain), and DepthOfField.
All interactive DOM elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use dark colors as gradients. Stick strictly to the #E9EDF2 -> #C9D1DA light theme range.
Don't make generic centered layouts. The HUD must sit at the absolute edges of the screen with precise padding (e.g., p-8).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters for DOM overlays (bg-white/40 backdrop-blur-lg).
Create depth through layered design elements (Canvas at z-0, Post-processing at z-10, HUD at z-50).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭).
Ensure all DOM transitions use Framer Motion or specific CSS transitions (excluding transform).
CRITICAL: Do not use complete transparent background for overlays. Always use a tint with backdrop-blur to maintain text readability.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="sound-toggle"`, `data-testid="close-overlay"`).
Ensure text contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards. The dark slate text (#1B2330) against the light grey world (#E9EDF2) achieves excellent contrast.
Implement focus states for keyboard navigation on the 'Sound: On/Off' and Overlay Close buttons.
For the text scramble effect, ensure it settles on readable text quickly (under 800ms) to prevent cognitive overload.
